title: Your tuition refund closes today
scenario: An email says your university overcharged tuition and a refund must be claimed by 5 p.m. The link opens a university-looking page asking for your student login and bank details.

answers.A: Contact the bursar/student finance office through a known university channel.
answers.B: Use the link because the email includes your student ID and exact program name.
answers.C: Open the student finance portal from the university website you already use and check for the refund there.

explanation: Student details are often available from compromised accounts or public sources. Refunds should appear in the institution’s own finance system.
proTip: A refund is not urgent enough to borrow someone else’s login page.
